title: 국회의원수당 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text: Article 3 (Standards for Payment and Adjustment of Expenses for Legislative Activities) Monthly expenses for legislative activities paid to members of the National Assembly shall be paid according to the standards specified in Appendix 2 until the Act is amended: Provided, That where the Speaker of the National Assembly deems it necessary to adjust such expenses before these Rules are amended, the Speaker may determine the adjustment within budgetary limits.
